title: Faerie Dragon
wikitext:
[[image:faerie.jpg|thumb|]]Small flying lizards. They look much like a chameleon with butterfly wings. Though not actual Dragons, these mystical looking creatures police the [[Emerald Dream]] from magic. 

They have long been used by the [[Night Elves]] in their endeavours.

'''Also known as:'''
* Sprite
* Blink dragon

Alliance players can get a [[Sprite Darter Hatchling]] as a novelty pet.
